tone: English, first person, casual UGC. Keep every line speakable in one breath.
guidelines: Project contains 2 task sections: a) Reading section and b) Action section.
EVERY individual task needs to be done within EACH section!
READING section has 2 parts: a) close-up with phone, b) waist-up talking.
Complete each individual task and submit videos (in HD quality) within 7 days of project assignment.
IMPORTANT For faster review/approval: Submit videos in the same sequence as the tasks (corresponding 1st task = 1st video you attach)
Make 1 SUBMISSION for READING section tasks, and 1 separate SUBMISSION for ACTION section tasks. Do NOT mix up Reading vs Action tasks/videos into 1 submission! This WILL lead to payout delays!
Do NOT record against a "white wall" background. Please record anywhere else, ex: living room on the sofa, kitchen, patio, anywhere where your background isn't just a white wall.
readingIntro: Feel free to use a teleprompter or script, but please keep your eye movements natural. We want the video to feel like a conversation, not a reading session
Please note: If the video clearly shows you reading from a script or if your eye movements look unnatural, we will require a reshoot.

actionIntro: 1. According to the reference image, repeat the movement 1:1.
2. Just repeat the movement, no need subtitle.
3. Read the line attached while doing action (if there's no line below then don't).
4. Please disregard the gender of the person in the reference image. There is no need for a corresponding gender to appear on camera. Simply ensure your movements match or resemble those shown.

actionTasks.title: Typing the boring way
actionTasks.spec: 9:16, No voiceover needed. Shoot separately. (~5-6 seconds)
steps: Sit on the sofa, holding your phone with both hands.
Type slowly with a flat, unimpressed face, then sigh and let your shoulders drop.
actionTasks.imageCaption: Reference: hand tapping keys on the phone keyboard.

actionTasks.title: Scroll and jaw-drop
actionTasks.spec: 9:16, No voiceover needed. Shoot separately. (~4-5 seconds)
steps: Hold the phone up in portrait, screen facing you.
Scroll through themes quickly with your thumb, then widen your eyes and let your jaw drop.
actionTasks.imageCaption: Reference: finger swiping through keyboard themes.

actionTasks.title: Tap-tap delight
actionTasks.spec: 9:16, No voiceover needed. Shoot separately. (~5 seconds)
steps: Hold the phone with the keyboard facing you, and tap a few keys quickly with a small smile.
Tilt the phone slightly toward the camera but keep the screen glare out of frame, then nod once.
actionTasks.imageCaption: Reference: fingers tapping a themed keyboard.

actionTasks.title: Match the lock screen
actionTasks.spec: 9:16, No voiceover needed. Shoot separately. (~5 seconds)
steps: Hold two phones side by side, one showing the keyboard and one showing the lock screen, bottoms facing the camera.
Look at them, then at the camera, and smile like you just got away with something.
actionTasks.imageCaption: Reference: themed keyboard and matching lock screen held together.
